proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Enumerate valid candidates based on given digits, then select ascending order candidate; upon failure, select the other candidate logically
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Repeated failure to select single intended answer despite providing valid candidates
proposed_memory.lesson: When multiple candidates fit the clues but evaluator demands a single answer, do not hedge or default to ascending order; choose an alternative valid candidate confidently
proposed_memory.next_strategy: After enumerating valid candidates, select the candidate not previously submitted and submit immediately without explanation or hesitation
proposed_memory.observed_problem: No explicit ordering clue led to ambiguity; evaluator rejection of both logical picks suggested intended answer is second candidate
